## What Acciyo Delivers

Welcome to Acciyo, where we help readers invest smarter and skip the regret. Our home page

online. We curate and analyze, filtering noise so you can rely on what is genuinely worthwhile. We
cover practical guidance, product reliability, price clarity, and privacy considerations, all
grounded in real-world usage. Our goal is to empower you with clear, actionable insights that stand
up in daily life.

Manifesto

Dünya sadece bize miras değil, gelecek nesillere bırakacağımız bir emanettir. Yolculuklarımız sadece
ayak izlerimizden ibaret değildir; düşüncelerimiz, eylemlerimiz ve hislerimiz de geride bir iz
bırakır.

İşte bu yüzden, Akra Hotels olarak biz, turizmi yalnızca bir iş sektörü olarak değil, aynı zamanda
bir sorumluluk olarak görüyoruz.

Biz, Ethical Tourism programımızla, sürdürülebilir ve dünyaya saygılı turizm anlayışını savunuyoruz.
Tüketmek yerine üretmeyi, almak yerine paylaşmayı seçiyoruz. Çünkü biliyoruz ki gerçek keşif,
gezdiğimiz yerleri değiştirmek değil, onların ruhunu anlamaktır. Akra Hotels olarak, sürdürülebilir
bir dünya için somut adımlar atıyoruz.

Güneşten aldığımız enerjiyle aydınlanıyor, doğanın bize sunduğu kaynakları bilinçli kullanıyoruz.
Yerel üreticileri destekliyor, toplumsal kalkınmayı önemsiyoruz. Cinsiyet eşitliğine katkıda
bulunuyor, bulunduğumuz çevreye değer katan projeler üretiyoruz. Ekosistemin korunması için
çalışıyor, denizlerimizi, ormanlarımızı ve şehirlerimizi geleceğe taşıyoruz.

* [Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynaklarına Yönelim: Güneş Enerji Santrallerimiz][20]
  
  Güneş, yalnızca bir saat içinde gezegenimizin bir yıllık enerji ihtiyacından fazlasını
  sağlayabilecek güce sahiptir. BHM Otelcilik olarak bu potansiyelin farkında, dünyaya karşı
  sorumluluğumuzun bilincinde hareket ediyoruz. Bu doğrultuda, 2022 yılından itibaren enerji
  yatırımlarımızı güneş enerjisine yönlendirdik ve sürdürülebilirliğin devamı için gerekli adımları
  hayata geçirdik.
  
  Akra Antalya, Akra V, Akra Kemer, Akra Sorgun, Akra Fethiye ve Akra Fethiye The Residence
  otellerimizin yıllık elektrik ihtiyacını kendi enerji kaynaklarımızla karşılıyoruz. Ethical
  Tourism çatısı altında gerçekleştirdiğimiz bu adımlar sayesinde karbon emisyonumuzu azaltıyor,
  doğaya olan katkımızı artırıyoruz.
  
  2022 yılında Döşemealtı ve Aksu’da, 2023’te Afyon Sandıklı’da, 2024’te Alanya ve Elmalı
  Bayındır’da güneş enerjisi santrallerimiz devreye alındı. Son olarak, 2025 yılı Mart ayında Elmalı
  Kışlaköy GES projemiz faaliyete geçti. Tüm santrallerimiz toplamda 21 mWp kurulu güce sahiptir.
  
  2024 yılı boyunca faaliyette olan bu santrallerimizden toplam 18.990.945 kWh elektrik üretildi ve
  bu üretim, toplam tüketimimizin yaklaşık %65’ini karşıladı. Hedefimiz, gelecekteki yatırımlarımız
  ve enerji tasarrufuna yönelik önlemlerle 33 milyon kWh üretim kapasitesine ulaşmak ve elektrik
  ihtiyacımızın %100’ünü güneş enerjisinden karşılamaktır.
  
  2024 yılında gerçekleştirdiğimiz 17 elektrikli araç yatırımıyla, yılda 39 ton karbon emisyonunu
  azaltmayı hedefleyerek karbon ayak izimizi düşürüyoruz. Ayrıca, yeni araçlarımızda kullanılan
  elektriği güneş enerjisi santralimizden karşılayarak sürdürülebilirliğe katkı sağlıyoruz.

Manifesto

Dünya sadece bize miras değil, gelecek nesillere bırakacağımız bir emanettir. Yolculuklarımız sadece
ayak izlerimizden ibaret değildir; düşüncelerimiz, eylemlerimiz ve hislerimiz de geride bir iz
bırakır.

İşte bu yüzden, Akra Hotels olarak biz, turizmi yalnızca bir iş sektörü olarak değil, aynı zamanda
bir sorumluluk olarak görüyoruz.

Biz, Ethical Tourism programımızla, sürdürülebilir ve dünyaya saygılı turizm anlayışını savunuyoruz.
Tüketmek yerine üretmeyi, almak yerine paylaşmayı seçiyoruz. Çünkü biliyoruz ki gerçek keşif,
gezdiğimiz yerleri değiştirmek değil, onların ruhunu anlamaktır. Akra Hotels olarak, sürdürülebilir
bir dünya için somut adımlar atıyoruz.

Güneşten aldığımız enerjiyle aydınlanıyor, doğanın bize sunduğu kaynakları bilinçli kullanıyoruz.
Yerel üreticileri destekliyor, toplumsal kalkınmayı önemsiyoruz. Cinsiyet eşitliğine katkıda
bulunuyor, bulunduğumuz çevreye değer katan projeler üretiyoruz. Ekosistemin korunması için
çalışıyor, denizlerimizi, ormanlarımızı ve şehirlerimizi geleceğe taşıyoruz.

* [Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynaklarına Yönelim: Güneş Enerji Santrallerimiz][20]
  
  Güneş, yalnızca bir saat içinde gezegenimizin bir yıllık enerji ihtiyacından fazlasını
  sağlayabilecek güce sahiptir. BHM Otelcilik olarak bu potansiyelin farkında, dünyaya karşı
  sorumluluğumuzun bilincinde hareket ediyoruz. Bu doğrultuda, 2022 yılından itibaren enerji
  yatırımlarımızı güneş enerjisine yönlendirdik ve sürdürülebilirliğin devamı için gerekli adımları
  hayata geçirdik.
  
  Akra Antalya, Akra V, Akra Kemer, Akra Sorgun, Akra Fethiye ve Akra Fethiye The Residence
  otellerimizin yıllık elektrik ihtiyacını kendi enerji kaynaklarımızla karşılıyoruz. Ethical
  Tourism çatısı altında gerçekleştirdiğimiz bu adımlar sayesinde karbon emisyonumuzu azaltıyor,
  doğaya olan katkımızı artırıyoruz.
  
  2022 yılında Döşemealtı ve Aksu’da, 2023’te Afyon Sandıklı’da, 2024’te Alanya ve Elmalı
  Bayındır’da güneş enerjisi santrallerimiz devreye alındı. Son olarak, 2025 yılı Mart ayında Elmalı
  Kışlaköy GES projemiz faaliyete geçti. Tüm santrallerimiz toplamda 21 mWp kurulu güce sahiptir.
  
  2024 yılı boyunca faaliyette olan bu santrallerimizden toplam 18.990.945 kWh elektrik üretildi ve
  bu üretim, toplam tüketimimizin yaklaşık %65’ini karşıladı. Hedefimiz, gelecekteki yatırımlarımız
  ve enerji tasarrufuna yönelik önlemlerle 33 milyon kWh üretim kapasitesine ulaşmak ve elektrik
  ihtiyacımızın %100’ünü güneş enerjisinden karşılamaktır.
  
  2024 yılında gerçekleştirdiğimiz 17 elektrikli araç yatırımıyla, yılda 39 ton karbon emisyonunu
  azaltmayı hedefleyerek karbon ayak izimizi düşürüyoruz. Ayrıca, yeni araçlarımızda kullanılan
  elektriği güneş enerjisi santralimizden karşılayarak sürdürülebilirliğe katkı sağlıyoruz.

* [Biyoçeşitliliğin Korunması:][25]
  
  Caretta carettalar, kum zambağı ve nesli tehlike altındaki bitki ve hayvan türlerinin korunmasına
  yönelik projeler yürütüyor, doğal yaşam alanlarını koruyoruz; otellerimizin bulunduğu doğadaki
  hayvanları koruyoruz. Fidan bağışı ve ağaç dikimi projelerine destek oluyoruz. 
  
  Side bölgesinde deniz ve kıyı ekolojisinin korunması için mücadele eden DEKAFOK ile
  gerçekleştirdiğimiz iş birliği sayesinde, sahilimizdeki caretta caretta yavruları, güvenli bir
  şekilde yumurtalarından çıkarak denize ulaşmaya devam ediyor. Doğaya ve çevreye olan
  hassasiyetimizi, bu özel türlerin korunmasına katkıda bulunarak sürdürüyoruz.  
  
  6 Eylül 2024 itibarıyla Akra Kemer’de çevre dostu bir misafir sadakati uygulaması başlattık.
  Tesisimizde 10’dan fazla konaklama gerçekleştiren misafirlerimiz adına fidan bağışı yaparak, OGEM
  Vakfı iş birliğiyle Türkiye’nin yeniden yeşillendirilmesine katkı sağlıyoruz. Küçük bir dokunuşla
  hep birlikte daha yeşil bir geleceğe destek oluyoruz.
* [Sürdürülebilir Seyahat Bilinci Oluşturma:][26]
  
  Misafirlerimizi sürdürülebilir turizm konusunda bilinçlendirmek ve onlara doğa dostu seyahat
  alternatifleri sunmak için çalışmalar yapıyoruz. 
  
  Akra Antalya, Akra V, Akra Sorgun, Akra Kemer, Akra Fethiye ve Akra Fethiye The Residence
  otellerimiz operasyon ve hizmetlerinin bir parçası olarak sürdürülebilir uygulamaları taahhüt
  ederek UNESCO tarafından geliştiren projeye dahil oldu.  Doğayı ve yerel kültürü korumak için
  çalışmalarımıza devam ediyor, misafirlerimizi de bu konuda bilinçlendiriyoruz. Örneğin, Akra
  Sorgun, 2024 yılı itibariyle sunduğu Bisiklet Dostu Otel olanakları ile sürdürülebilir yaşam
  faaliyetlerinin bir parçası olmaktadır. Bisiklet dostu konaklama tesisi sertifikası ile Akra
  Sorgun, Akra Kemer, Akra Antalya ve Akra V otellerimizde bisiklet kullanımını teşvik ediyoruz,
  ücretli ve ücretsiz bisiklet hizmetleri verip, bisikleti ile konaklayan misafirlerimize de özel
  park yeri imkânı, bakım ve onarım alanı, bisiklet rotaları ile güncel hava ve yol durumu bilgisine
  sahip danışma ekibi, sporculara özel beslenme menüleri, 24 saat yıkama gibi ek hizmetleri ile
  ayrıcalıklı bir sürdürülebilir tatil yaşatıyoruz.

** ** **THE TRANSFORMATION OF TRAVEL**

# **We believe in the power of sustainable tourism to make the world better.**

At Beyond Green Travel, we work with destinations, hospitality companies, tour operators and
non-profit groups to build their brands, craft compelling stories and make travel a force for good.
For over 20 years, we have been on the cutting edge of travel innovation and leadership, helping to
spearhead the global sustainable tourism movement that supports conservation, cultural preservation,
and economic development through business success. We help companies and destinations become
sustainability leaders for a new generation of travelers seeking the trip of a lifetime that also
gives back to local people and the planet.

### PROFESSIONAL SERVICES

With more places to go and more ways to get there than ever before, we provide innovative solutions
that make tourism a positive opportunity for business and the planet alike. From protecting nature
to ensuring social and economic benefits for local communities, our expertise is unsurpassed. We
build success through sustainable tourism leadership - including product development and assessment,
branding, marketing, storytelling, educational training and workshops. Our winning track record
includes the world’s top travel companies and destinations.

[ Learn More ][12]

### Sustainable Tourism

Beyond Green Travel has been passionately engaged with steering tourism in the right direction from
our beginnings. We have proven that doing well by doing good benefits both the planet and businesses
alike, and we help like-minded partners - from companies to countries - develop these strategies
through our diverse professional services.

[ Learn more ][13]

### **OUR STORY**

Beyond Green Travel was founded in 2005 by Costas Christ, a global sustainable tourism pioneer and
visionary, who together with his wife Sally Christ, grew Beyond Green Travel into one of the world's
most respected sustainable travel and destination stewardship consultancy firms. Beyond Green Travel
was acquired in 2020 by Preferred Hotel Group and now sells its services through [PTG
Consulting][14], the corporate entity’s consulting division.

** ** **THE TRANSFORMATION OF TRAVEL**

# **We believe in the power of sustainable tourism to make the world better.**

At Beyond Green Travel, we work with destinations, hospitality companies, tour operators and
non-profit groups to build their brands, craft compelling stories and make travel a force for good.
For over 20 years, we have been on the cutting edge of travel innovation and leadership, helping to
spearhead the global sustainable tourism movement that supports conservation, cultural preservation,
and economic development through business success. We help companies and destinations become
sustainability leaders for a new generation of travelers seeking the trip of a lifetime that also
gives back to local people and the planet.

### PROFESSIONAL SERVICES

With more places to go and more ways to get there than ever before, we provide innovative solutions
that make tourism a positive opportunity for business and the planet alike. From protecting nature
to ensuring social and economic benefits for local communities, our expertise is unsurpassed. We
build success through sustainable tourism leadership - including product development and assessment,
branding, marketing, storytelling, educational training and workshops. Our winning track record
includes the world’s top travel companies and destinations.

[ Learn More ][12]

### Sustainable Tourism

Beyond Green Travel has been passionately engaged with steering tourism in the right direction from
our beginnings. We have proven that doing well by doing good benefits both the planet and businesses
alike, and we help like-minded partners - from companies to countries - develop these strategies
through our diverse professional services.

[ Learn more ][13]

### **OUR STORY**

Beyond Green Travel was founded in 2005 by Costas Christ, a global sustainable tourism pioneer and
visionary, who together with his wife Sally Christ, grew Beyond Green Travel into one of the world's
most respected sustainable travel and destination stewardship consultancy firms. Beyond Green Travel
was acquired in 2020 by Preferred Hotel

## **About Us**

Kyrgyz Community Based Tourism Association “Hospitality Kyrgyzstan” (KCBTA), (the country’s driving
force behind CBT best practices and innovation) is leading the charge. The association’s objective
is to improve living conditions in remote mountain regions by developing a sustainable and wholesome
ecotourism model that utilizes local natural and recreational resources. Located in the capital
Bishkek, KCBTA is an umbrella association uniting 17 diverse destination communities (“CBT groups”).

The CBT association was registered on January 3, 2003 with support from Helvetas Kyrgyzstan
Programme’s Community Based Tourism Support Project (CBT SP) with operations throughout the country.

## **About Us**

Kyrgyz Community Based Tourism Association “Hospitality Kyrgyzstan” (KCBTA), (the country’s driving
force behind CBT best practices and innovation) is leading the charge. The association’s objective
is to improve living conditions in remote mountain regions by developing a sustainable and wholesome
ecotourism model that utilizes local natural and recreational resources. Located in the capital
Bishkek, KCBTA is an umbrella association uniting 17 diverse destination communities (“CBT groups”).

The CBT association was registered on January 3, 2003 with support from Helvetas Kyrgyzstan
Programme’s Community Based Tourism Support Project (CBT SP) with operations throughout the country.

Village Life

## [Six Months in a Village of 400 People: What I Learned and What Surprised Me][6]

When my partner and I decided to leave Madrid and try living in a small village in Extremadura,
everyone thought we were having some kind of crisis. That was eighteen months ago. We're still here.

By Marta Iglesias  |  17 July 2025
Food

## [The Markets You Should Be Going to Instead of the Obvious Ones][7]

Every city in Spain has a famous market that appears in every guidebook. They're usually fine. But
the ones I keep going back to are the ones that nobody writes about — the neighbourhood mercados
that still serve the people who live nearby.

By Carlos Herrero  |  10 July 2025
History

## [The Castle Nobody Visits (and Why That's a Good Thing)][8]

There are hundreds of medieval castles in Spain. Most of them are either heavily restored and full
of tourists, or completely inaccessible. But there's a third category — the ones that are just sort
of there, unlocked, unguarded, and spectacular.

By Marta Iglesias  |  3 July 2025
Practical

## [Getting Around Spain Without a Car: It's More Possible Than You Think][9]

Spain's rail network is genuinely excellent between major cities. The gaps are real but manageable
if you plan around them. A guide based on actual experience, not press releases.

By Carlos Herrero  |  25 June 2025

# 歴史をつなぐ
# 未来にのこす道後温泉本館

約3000年の歴史を誇り、日本最古といわれる道後温泉のシンボルである「道後温泉本館」は、平成6年12月に公
衆浴場で初めて、国の重要文化財に指定されました。松山市はもちろん、国の宝である本館を次世代へ大切に引
き継いでいくため、平成31年1月から始まった保存修理工事は令和6年12月に完了しました。

[道後温泉本館][62]

# 歴史をつなぐ
# 未来にのこす道後温泉本館

約3000年の歴史を誇り、日本最古といわれる道後温泉のシンボルである「道後温泉本館」は、平成6年12月に公
衆浴場で初めて、国の重要文化財に指定されました。松山市はもちろん、国の宝である本館を次世代へ大切に引
き継いでいくため、平成31年1月から始まった保存修理工事は令和6年12月に完了しました。

# 歴史をつなぐ
# 未来にのこす道後温泉本館

約3000年の歴史を誇り、日本最古といわれる道後温泉のシンボルである「道後温泉本館」は、平成6年12月に公
衆浴場で初めて、国の重要文化財に指定されました。松山市はもちろん、国の宝である本館を次世代へ大切に引
き継いでいくため、平成31年1月から始まった保存修理工事は令和6年12月に完了しました。

## Do you want to contribute to shaping the tourism of the future? Are you interested in tourism and
## sustainable development?
## 
## The DSTS Master programme offers you the interdisciplinary knowledge and professional skills
## necessary to enter the complex world of tourism and make it a pivotal asset in ensuring a better
## future for all.
## 
## This degree course will provide you with competences for the sustainable management and
## organization of tourism activities based on the economic, natural, historical, and cultural
## heritage of the territory. You will acquire demographic and statistical skills to measure and
## monitor the social and economic impacts of tourism, and gain knowledge about the new trends of
## food as a strategic driver in producing value with sustainable tourism, promoting the
## preservation of rural development and biodiversity. Basic legal and contractual concepts related
## to tourism actions and travel activities will also be provided.
## 
## Our graduates aspire to become leaders in the enhancement of the natural, historical, and
## cultural resources of the territory; in the organization of local events and in the promotion of
## territories; in the construction of a multifaceted touristic offer, with specific expertise to
## meet the increasing demand for sustainability.

## Do you want to contribute to shaping the tourism of the future? Are you interested in tourism and
## sustainable development?
## 
## The DSTS Master programme offers you the interdisciplinary knowledge and professional skills
## necessary to enter the complex world of tourism and make it a pivotal asset in ensuring a better
## future for all.
## 
## This degree course will provide you with competences for the sustainable management and
## organization of tourism activities based on the economic, natural, historical, and cultural
## heritage of the territory. You will acquire demographic and statistical skills to measure and
## monitor the social and economic impacts of tourism, and gain knowledge about the new trends of
## food as a strategic driver in producing value with sustainable tourism, promoting the
## preservation of rural development and biodiversity. Basic legal and contractual concepts related
## to tourism actions and travel activities will also be provided.
## 
## Our graduates aspire to become leaders in the enhancement of the natural, historical, and
## cultural resources of the territory; in the organization of local events and in the promotion of
## territories; in the construction of a multifaceted touristic offer, with specific expertise to
## meet the increasing demand for sustainability.

# Ethical Tourism: Travel That
# Asks “Is This Right?”

By [Steven Keen][27]

MSc Responsible Tourism Management (in progress), GSTC- and ICRT-certified

8 min read • Updated on Jul 17, 2026 • [ Sources verified on Jul 17, 2026 ][28]

Discover how ethical tourism puts the moral question back into travel. Explore evidence-based guides
to human rights, animal welfare, and cultural integrity—grounded in the UN’s Global Code of Ethics
for Tourism—and learn to see what the brochure leaves out.

## Three Approaches, One Goal: Better Tourism

Ethical, responsible, and inclusive tourism share common ground while emphasizing different
priorities. Together, they form a comprehensive vision for travel that benefits everyone.

Shared EthicalResponsibleInclusive

All three treat tourism as a human-rights matter with real duty-bearers, and aim for fair,
respectful, and future-proof travel. What Ethical, Responsible, and Inclusive Tourism share is a
common foundation and intent:
* Do more good than harm—for people, nature, animals, and the economy alike, recognizing their
  interdependence.
* Reject exploitation, harm, destruction, and instrumentalization of places, people, or culture for
  profit or experience.
* Ask not “how do we attract more visitors?” but instead “how do we leave this place stronger than
  we found it?”

One shared goal—fair, respectful, future-proof tourism—viewed through three distinct but
complementary lenses.

Key topics
* Labor rights, fair wages, safe conditions
* Child protection, anti-trafficking
* Animal welfare—no rides, shows, or selfies
* Cultural integrity, avoiding “human zoos”
* Transparency, anti-greenwashing

Frameworks
* UN Global Code of Ethics for Tourism
* UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights
* UN Guiding Principles on Business & Human Rights
* ILO labor conventions
* Animal welfare (Five Freedoms)

How do we ensure no one (people, animals, cultures) is exploited or harmed for our trips? Is what we
are doing morally right?

Key topics
* Contribution to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs)
* Carbon, climate & resource use
* Local economic benefit
* Overtourism & destination management
* Measurable indicators, honest reporting

Frameworks
* UN SDGs (esp. 8, 11–15)
* Cape Town Declaration (2002)
* UN Tourism & WTTC guidelines

How do we ensure tourism doesn’t harm—but strengthens places and people, and how do we shape it so
they benefit long term?

More on this at [responsibletourism.com][29].

Key topics
* Accessibility of transport, hotels & attractions
* Universal design—for all
* Rights of persons with disabilities (UN CRPD)
* Accessible, screen-reader-friendly information
* Employment of people with disabilities

Frameworks
* UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UN CRPD, Articles 9 & 30)
* UN Tourism—Accessible Tourism for All
* European & national accessibility laws
* Universal Design principles

Can every person, regardless of ability or limitation, take part on equal terms? How do we ensure
everyone can participate?

More on this at [inclusivetourism.com][30].

# Ethical Tourism: Travel That
# Asks “Is This Right?”

By [Steven Keen][27]

MSc Responsible Tourism Management (in progress), GSTC- and ICRT-certified

8 min read • Updated on Jul 17, 2026 • [ Sources verified on Jul 17, 2026 ][28]

Discover how ethical tourism puts the moral question back into travel. Explore evidence-based guides
to human rights, animal welfare, and cultural integrity—grounded in the UN’s Global Code of Ethics
for Tourism—and learn to see what the brochure leaves out.

## Three Approaches, One Goal: Better Tourism

Ethical, responsible, and inclusive tourism share common ground while emphasizing different
priorities. Together, they form a comprehensive vision for travel that benefits everyone.

Shared EthicalResponsibleInclusive

All three treat tourism as a human-rights matter with real duty-bearers, and aim for fair,
respectful, and future-proof travel. What Ethical, Responsible, and Inclusive Tourism share is a
common foundation and intent:
* Do more good than harm—for people, nature, animals, and the economy alike, recognizing their
  interdependence.
* Reject exploitation, harm, destruction, and instrumentalization of places, people, or culture for
  profit or experience.
* Ask not “how do we attract more visitors?” but instead “how do we leave this place stronger than
  we found it?”

One shared goal—fair, respectful, future-proof tourism—viewed through three distinct but
complementary lenses.

Key topics
* Labor rights, fair wages, safe conditions
* Child protection, anti-trafficking
* Animal welfare—no rides, shows, or selfies
* Cultural integrity, avoiding “human zoos”
* Transparency, anti-greenwashing

Frameworks
* UN Global Code of Ethics for Tourism
* UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights
* UN Guiding Principles on Business & Human Rights
* ILO labor conventions
* Animal welfare (Five Freedoms)

How do we ensure no one (people, animals, cultures) is exploited or harmed for our trips? Is what we
are doing morally right?

Key topics
* Contribution to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs)
* Carbon, climate & resource use
* Local economic benefit
* Overtourism & destination management
* Measurable indicators, honest reporting

Frameworks
* UN SDGs (esp. 8, 11–15)
* Cape Town Declaration (2002)
* UN Tourism & WTTC guidelines

How do we ensure tourism doesn’t harm—but strengthens places and people, and how do we shape it so
they benefit long term?

More on this at [responsibletourism.com][29].

Key topics
* Accessibility of transport, hotels & attractions
* Universal design—for all
* Rights of persons with disabilities (UN CRPD)
* Accessible, screen-reader-friendly information
* Employment of people with disabilities

Frameworks
* UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UN CRPD, Articles 9 & 30)
* UN Tourism—Accessible Tourism for All
* European & national accessibility laws
* Universal Design principles

Can every person, regardless of ability or limitation, take part on equal terms? How do we ensure
everyone can participate?

More on this at [inclusivetourism.com][30].

# WE SOURCE NATURE
# TO RESOURCE THE FUTURE

PIONEERING ETHICAL BIOTECHNOLOGIES

Pionnier des biotechnologies, le Groupe Greentech crée des ingrédients actifs de haute technologie
depuis des sources naturelles issues des mondes végétaux, marins et microbiens. Adressées à de
grands marchés - cosmétique, nutrition, agronomie, environnement, santé et bien-être - les
innovations du Groupe Greentech représentent

des alternatives éprouvées, saines et durables, au service des générations futures.


Le Groupe Greentech aujourd’hui opère dans le monde entier en créant des filières durables fondées
sur le respect de l’environnement et des liens humains.

[> EN SAVOIR PLUS][9]

## NOS MARCHÉS

Nous sommes un groupe aux compétences croisées qui se nourissent les unes les autres. Cette
‘‘cross-fertilisation’’ de nos expertises – sur nos grands marchés de la cosmétique, de l'agronomie,
de la nutrition, de l’environnement et de la santé – est un atout fondamental. Sur ces marchés, nos
sociétés sont des acteurs de l’avenir, répondant aux nécessités planétaires, et aux nouvelles
attentes des consommateurs; nous sommes fiers, au sein du Groupe Greentech, de produire sans
détruire, et d’apporter des solutions concrètes, efficaces et naturelles. Ce sont nos réponses aux
enjeux de demain.

Jean-Yves Berthon, fondateur et CEO de Greentech :


"Greentech est fier d’être partenaire du Pavillon France à l’Exposition universelle de Dubaï et
notamment de la quinzaine dédiée aux Océans du 18 au 31 mars 2022.

La grande thématique de l’exposition est « Making a new world », un nouveau monde qui se devra de
connecter les peuples, les cultures et les sciences. C'est une dynamique qui nous guide depuis 30
ans vers la mise sur le marché d’ingrédients novateurs et durables à partir de végétaux, d’algues,
de micro-organismes. Une fertilisation croisée de toutes ces biotechnologies mises en valeur par les
savoir-faire et les compétences scientifiques et technologiques de nos équipes."

travel options coasts to coast.

Wednesday, 15 July 2026, under the auspices of the Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC). [HLPF in

## A little about me…

Hi, I’m **Michele**: photographer, travel writer, and your realistic adventure wingwoman.

Since 2018, I’ve been sharing thoughtful guides, storytelling, and outdoor adventures across the
U.S., Costa Rica, and beyond.

I believe meaningful travel doesn’t have to be far, expensive, or complicated.

I’m here to help you slow down, explore with purpose, and **fall in love with the details**, whether
you’re hiking through national parks or discovering local gems right in your backyard.

Let’s build a life filled with stories worth sharing.

[Get to know me more!][26]

place in my heart.

#  

# What Did You Forget to Put in Your Strategy?


## Most biotech founders don't fail because the science is weak.

## They fail because of what wasn't in the strategy at all.


###### You've built something real. The science is solid. The team is committed. But somewhere
###### between the lab and the market — something is missing.


###### Not wrong. Missing.

######  

###### And the hardest part is you can't see it from the inside.

[Find your blind spot ][7]

##  

Introducing

 

## The Blind Spot

##  

###### A free, private strategic assessment for early-stage biotech founders.


This is not a quiz. There is no automated score. No generic report generated by an algorithm.

You answer seven questions about your company — in your own words. Attila reads every submission
personally. Then you meet one-on-one online for a focused strategic session where the real diagnosis
happens.

 

You leave knowing exactly what your strategy is missing — and what to do about it.

 

 

## Why Most Biotech Strategies Stall - And It's Not the Science


After working with early-stage biotech founders from pre-seed to Series B, the pattern is always the
same.

The science is credible. The founder is sharp. But the strategy has gaps nobody has named out loud
yet.


The investor narrative sounds too academic. The milestone map tracks R&D but doesn't signal business
value. The commercial logic hasn't been built yet. The team gap nobody wants to talk about is
growing quietly in the background.


These are not small problems. They are the problems that kill fundable companies.


The Blind Spot finds them before they find you.

  

## What We Look At

###### 01

Your strategy and vision

Where is the company going in the next 5–10 years — and does the plan hold up when a skeptical
investor pushes back?

###### 02

Your market and urgency

Who needs what you're building — and why do they act now, not in three years?

###### 03

Your milestones

What do your next 3–5 milestones unlock for the business — not just for the R&D calendar?

###### 04

Your cash flow and runway

How are you managing burn — and what breaks first if your funding assumptions are wrong?

###### 05

Your team and organisation

What's the gap between the team you have today and the company you're building in the next 2–3
years?

###### 06

Your science as a system

Can you explain the core idea clearly enough for a smart non-scientist to act on it?

###### 07

Your external perception

What do investors, partners, and potential customers actually think about your company right now —
not what you hope they think?

[See which ones apply to you ][8]

## How The Blind Spot Works

###### Step 1

Reserve your spot

A limited number of sessions are available each month. This is not a webinar. Not a group call. It
is a private, focused session with Attila — reserved for founders who are serious about finding
what's missing.

###### Step 2

Receive the questions

You'll get an email with seven open-ended questions and a short NDA. No word limits. No templates.
Answer the way you think.

###### Step 3

Attila reads your answers

Every submission is read personally before the session. No algorithms. No automation. When you show
up to the meeting the diagnosis has already started.

###### Step 4

The live session

One hour online. Direct questions. Honest answers. The conversation goes where it needs to go — not
where it's comfortable.

###### Step 5

You receive the full session notes

Captured by Fathom and sent to you after the meeting. Everything discussed, nothing lost.

##  

## This Is Not for Every Biotech Founder


The Blind Spot is for early-stage biotech founders — pre-seed to Series B — who are building serious
science and are honest enough to ask what the strategy is missing.


It is not for founders who want validation. It is not for teams that aren't ready for a direct
conversation. It is not a sales call dressed up as a free assessment.


If you want someone to tell you everything looks good — this is the wrong session.


If you want to know what you haven't thought about — you're in the right place.

  


## What Happens After The Blind Spot?


Some founders leave the session with clarity they can act on immediately. Others realise the gaps
are bigger than they thought — and want to go deeper.


If that's the case, Timeline Strategy offers two ways to keep working together.


The Sprint — a focused strategic engagement to fix what's missing and build the business layer your
science deserves.


The Partnership — ongoing strategic support for founders who need a thinking partner on the business
side, not another vendor.


There is no pressure. No pitch. The session speaks for itself.

  

######  

###### Who Reads Your Answers?

# What Did You Forget to Put in Your Strategy?


## Most biotech founders don't fail because the science is weak.

## They fail because of what wasn't in the strategy at all.


###### You've built something real. The science is solid. The team is committed. But somewhere
###### between the lab and the market — something is missing.


###### Not wrong. Missing.

######  

###### And the hardest part is you can't see it from the inside.

[Find your blind spot ][7]

##  

Introducing

 

## The Blind Spot

##  

###### A free, private strategic assessment for early-stage biotech founders.


This is not a quiz. There is no automated score. No generic report generated by an algorithm.

You answer seven questions about your company — in your own words. Attila reads every submission
personally. Then you meet one-on-one online for a focused strategic session where the real diagnosis
happens.

 

You leave knowing exactly what your strategy is missing — and what to do about it.

 

 

## Why Most Biotech Strategies Stall - And It's Not the Science


After working with early-stage biotech founders from pre-seed to Series B, the pattern is always the
same.

The science is credible. The founder is sharp. But the strategy has gaps nobody has named out loud
yet.


The investor narrative sounds too academic. The milestone map tracks R&D but doesn't signal business
value. The commercial logic hasn't been built yet. The team gap nobody wants to talk about is
growing quietly in the background.


These are not small problems. They are the problems that kill fundable companies.


The Blind Spot finds them before they find you.

  

## What We Look At

###### 01

Your strategy and vision

Where is the company going in the next 5–10 years — and does the plan hold up when a skeptical
investor pushes back?

###### 02

Your market and urgency

Who needs what you're building — and why do they act now, not in three years?

###### 03

Your milestones

What do your next 3–5 milestones unlock for the business — not just for the R&D calendar?

###### 04

Your cash flow and runway

How are you managing burn — and what breaks first if your funding assumptions are wrong?

###### 05

Your team and organisation

What's the gap between the team you have today and the company you're building in the next 2–3
years?

###### 06

Your science as a system

Can you explain the core idea clearly enough for a smart non-scientist to act on it?

###### 07

Your external perception

What do investors, partners, and potential customers actually think about your company right now —
not what you hope they think?

[See which ones apply to you ][8]

## How The Blind Spot Works

###### Step 1

Reserve your spot

A limited number of sessions are available each month. This is not a webinar. Not a group call. It
is a private, focused session with Attila — reserved for founders who are serious about finding
what's missing.

###### Step 2

Receive the questions

You'll get an email with seven open-ended questions and a short NDA. No word limits. No templates.
Answer the way you think.

###### Step 3

Attila reads your answers

Every submission is read personally before the session. No algorithms. No automation. When you show
up to the meeting the diagnosis has already started.

###### Step 4

The live session

One hour online. Direct questions. Honest answers. The conversation goes where it needs to go — not
where it's comfortable.

###### Step 5

You receive the full session notes

Captured by Fathom and sent to you after the meeting. Everything discussed, nothing lost.

##  

## This Is Not for Every Biotech Founder


The Blind Spot is for early-stage biotech founders — pre-seed to Series B — who are building serious
science and are honest enough to ask what the strategy is missing.


It is not for founders who want validation. It is not for teams that aren't ready for a direct
conversation. It is not a sales call dressed up as a free assessment.


If you want someone to tell you everything looks good — this is the wrong session.


If you want to know what you haven't thought about — you're in the right place.

  


## What Happens After The Blind Spot?


Some founders leave the session with clarity they can act on immediately. Others realise the gaps
are bigger than they thought — and want to go deeper.


If that's the case, Timeline Strategy offers two ways to keep working together.


The Sprint — a focused strategic engagement to fix what's missing and build the business layer your
science deserves.


The Partnership — ongoing strategic support for founders who need a thinking partner on the business
side, not another vendor.


There is no pressure. No pitch. The session speaks for itself.

  

######  

###### Who Reads Your Answers?

# Pura Vida

## Bienvenido a Costa Rica

Costa Rica is the land of pura vida. Take the quiz to discover your traveler type—and where your
journey begins.

[ Start your journey ][44]

## About Costa Rica

### An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is
your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning
undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors
from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and
entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high
number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and
integrated health care practices.

[Snorkeling adventure caribbean]
Costa Rica regions

## Caribbean


An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of
Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

[ explore the region ][45]

[A bird's eye view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica regions

## Central Pacific


Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central
Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

[ explore the region ][46]

[Coffee beans]
Costa Rica Regions

## Central Valley


Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and
delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

[ explore the region ][47]

[An aerial view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica Regions

## Guanacaste


Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from
tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

[ explore the region ][48]

[Arenal volcano]
Costa Rica regions
